signal: linear indirect diffuse reflected radiance; signed reference; unscaled candidate

reference.convergence_rule: independent-seed references at the same SPP must agree within gate on combined interior and every ROI; previous checkpoints retained; mean of final two seeds is reference
reference.depth_check: compare depth8 and unlimited with identical seed/SPP; report truncation, do not silently call depth8 full transport
validation: emitter area and Le; no duplicate extracted triangles
native constant texture specialization only for exact constant semantics

regions.definition: nearest geometric primary hit instance labels, front facing; Chebyshev erosion radius2; discard background/emitter; at least16 pixels per ROI
regions.leak: eroded floor pixels whose segment to geometric emitter centre is occluded by either box; no radiance-dependent selection

candidate.summary: arithmetic temporal mean, 32 captures; report per-frame error and temporal spread separately

future_dynamic_recovery.rule: by frame128 meet static ROI gates against new-state reference and old-state residual <=10% of the old/new reference change; require nonzero measurable change

failure_policy: preserve failed checkpoints and gates; no threshold or ROI changes after opening candidates; oracle nonconvergence blocks strict quality claims; static Cornell is not complete phase acceptance
